svg.title: Swara
svg.desc: Swara: A fast LilyPond toolkit for Neovim: a Tree-sitter grammar, a Rust language server and a plugin release v0.1.1, MIT, Rust, 66 commits, 2 stars. The panel shows the LilyPond line \relative c' { c4 d e f | g1 } above the bar it engraves, with a playhead stepping across the notes.

g.text: A fast LilyPond toolkit for Neovim: a Tree-sitter
grammar, a Rust language server and a plugin
c d e f in quarter notes, then g held for the whole bar
